Title: Upstream re-ask backoff
Description: An adaptive charter with nobody answering re-asks the same unanswered plan request every tick forever (the v0.10.0 SS human WD-10 measurement: 601 of 635 events were this ticker noise). Back off the re-ask interval after K unanswered expiries, or hold one request open rather than expire-and-reopen. Deliberately DEFERRED OUT of v0.11.0 (ADR-0067 SS Deferred): it changes GOVERNED LIFECYCLE BEHAVIOR (the plan-request open/expire cycle itself), which under structural rule #2 mints a new WD-N plus its own ADR + gate - out of scope for a release whose defining posture is zero new capability. v0.11.0 governs only the DISPLAY of this volume (the audit read surface + the governed-actions@1 preset), not its cause.
